# Case 27: Banned because replaced by stacked Since and Hence openers
Skill: write-methods
Expected gates: G-STY-conn
Language: en
Snippet:
> Since the station moves in each cycle, the return distance changes. Since the return distance changes, the reserved energy is recomputed. Hence, the feasible region of the next cycle differs. Since this difference depends on the executed decisions, historical solutions may be infeasible.
Why it fails: every removed because became a sentence-initial Since, three in four sentences, plus Hence, which the reference papers never use. The causal chain needs rotated devices such as a same-subject participle, due to, or Consequently.
